note: THE COMMITTED TREE, AGAINST THE LIVE CockroachDB Cloud DATABASE mainline_demo, ON 2026-08-11. Target: scripts/deploy/local_furl.py, which serves the UNMODIFIED mainline_demo_api.app.handler and the real console dist over an emulated Lambda Function URL payload-2.0 event; the database under /v1/health is mainline-dev-31219.j77.aws-ap-southeast-1.cockroachlabs.cloud/mainline_demo. The route W1 added is present and reachable: the 404 that this file recorded on 2026-08-10 is GONE, and the endpoint now reaches its dispatcher. It fails there, on TWO defects, both outside this worker's files, both named with the line that causes them. (1) mainline_demo_api/db.py:309 opens every connection with row_factory=dict_row, which reads.py and health.py index by name; gate_run.py and scenario.py unpack the same rows POSITIONALLY (scenario.py:283 unpacks an 8-tuple, gate_run.py:272 subscripts row[3]). Through the app's own connection, scenario.resolve() therefore binds the STRING 'check_id' as a UUID parameter and CockroachDB answers 22P02. (2) With that mismatch neutralised in a scratchpad process - see corroborating_run, which is itself NOT PROVEN - beats 1, 2 and 3 produce 00000, 23514 gate_closed_when_issued (reported) and P0001 mainline.fn_permit_merge_gate (parsed) against the live Cloud cluster, the two runs are identical on the stable projection, and the permit is unchanged afterwards; beat 4 is refused 23503 disposition_signer_credential_id_fkey because gate_run.py derives signer_credential_id as sha256('cred'+'signer') while verticals/mainline/db/seeds/demo/demo_world.sql seeds digest('mainline-demo/credential/demo.signer','sha256'). Two derivations of one identifier. NOTHING IN THIS FILE WAS RELAXED TO REACH A GREEN: the four expectations are the ones docs/deploy/gate-run-contract.md states, and this run does not meet them.

corroborating_run.note: SCRATCHPAD DIAGNOSTIC, NOT THE ACCEPTANCE RUN, AND ITS VERDICT IS ALSO NOT PROVEN. Identical to the primary run in every respect except one: mainline_demo_api.db._open was replaced, in this process only, with the same psycopg.connect call carrying a row factory whose rows are BOTH dicts (what reads.py and health.py index by name) and sequences (what gate_run.py and scenario.py unpack positionally). No repository file was edited. It exists to answer one question: how much of the demo is behind that single mismatch? ANSWER, measured against the LIVE CockroachDB Cloud database mainline_demo on 2026-08-11: all of it except beat 4. POST /v1/demo/gate-run answers 200; beats 1-3 produce 00000, 23514 gate_closed_when_issued (reported) and P0001 mainline.fn_permit_merge_gate (parsed); the two runs are identical on the stable projection; and the seeded permit's open_blocking, state, gate_epoch and head_seq are unchanged after both runs, read back from GET /v1/permits/{id}. Beat 4 is refused 23503 disposition_signer_credential_id_fkey, which is a SECOND and independent defect: gate_run.py writes signer_credential_id = sha256('cred'+'signer') = 487adc50409e8811b1f12055ee183ce9d8548f11262807d01776fb67cd09c765, and verticals/mainline/db/seeds/demo/demo_world.sql seeds credential_id = digest('mainline-demo/credential/demo.signer','sha256') = ff356d1461921438bbbc5d644db8793669cb948a46bddc2e8fb5ebef959bdf0c. Two derivations of one identifier; neither program reads the other's.
